entities.name: MINAR1 (Q9UPX6)
observations: The 768-aa query is an exact full-query match to reviewed human MINAR1 (UniProt Q9UPX6); predicted mass 86.2 kDa and pI 6.56.
MINAR1 is annotated as intrinsically disordered and as a single-pass type IV membrane protein localized to the cell membrane.
MINAR1 may negatively regulate mTOR signaling by stabilizing DEPTOR; it is also reported to negatively regulate angiogenesis and cell growth.
Pfam scanning detected MINAR1_N (PF22948.2) at residues 6–100; no other domain was reported by this scan.
Reported interactions: MINAR1 interacts with NOTCH2, which increases MINAR1 stability; its N-terminus interacts with DEPTOR's PDZ domain, potentially reducing DEPTOR ubiquitination.

entities.name: DEPTOR
observations: Human MINAR1 is reported to interact with DEPTOR via its N-terminus; this may stabilize DEPTOR by impairing its ubiquitination.

entities.name: NOTCH2
observations: Human MINAR1 is reported to interact with NOTCH2; this interaction increases MINAR1 stability.
